title:
Epic to store the data for the experimental model preview chart, alerts grid, features grid,
and other related data in the application state.
This epic listens for actions of type `SET_EXPERIMENT_STATUS_FIELD` and calls the `ExperimentalPreviewHelper#getData`.
It then updates the `isDataStoredInState` to `true` and `experimentModelPreviewData` with the fetched data, in the {@link ModelExperimentApplicationState}
name: StoreModelExperimentPreviewDataEpic
